answer: Charge admission per key: an agent identity only exists once its operator locks a jade bond in escrow, and the orchard of paid tasks allocates jobs per bonded dollar, not per key. Fees — nectar — flow only to bonds that complete unique, hash-verified work; duplicated output triggers slashing of every linked stake. So 1,000 sybils need 1,000 locked bonds yet earn the same total as one honest operator — no upside, and one collusion proof burns the lot.
